test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: When was the Majority Act, which defines the age of the majority of Indian citizens, passed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1875.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The **Majority Act of 1875 **is divided into two sections:
 
• **Section 3(1)**
 
 
• Every person domiciled in India shall attain the age of majority on completion of 18 years and not before. 
 
• Unless a particular personal law specifies otherwise, every person domiciled in India is deemed to have attained majority upon completion of 18 years of age. 
 
 
 
• **Section 3(2)**
 
 
• In computing the age of any person, the day on which he was born is to be included as a whole day and he shall be deemed to have attained majority at the beginning of the eighteenth anniversary of that day. 
 
• But if the child born is appointed a guardian or he/she is under the court of wards then he/she attains majority after his completion of 21 years of age.
